svg.aria-label: The Reader's Contents drawer, three times. Left, a book with parts: the cover tile, the title and the author in the head with the Recall pencil, the notebook and the close button, then Contents, Bookmarks and Where you've been as tabs with the chosen one underlined; Front matter folded; Parte I, II and III as uppercase bands; each chapter with its number, its title and a node on one vertical rail — filled for read, half for the chapter you are in, hollow for not yet — a yellow tick where you marked something; the chapter you are in tinted with an accent edge, saying You're here and the minutes left, its sections open under it with the one you are in lit; Back matter folded. Middle, a paper: numbers in their own column and the page each entry starts on, with dotted leaders, the section you are on lit. Right, a long book's Find in contents: typing comment keeps only the chapters and sections that match, the match marked; and a search that matches nothing says so in one line.
svg.text: PARTE II. LOS SISTEMAS Y NOSOTROS
Vivir en un mundo de sistemas
a book: parts as bands, the reading rail, you're here
Numbers in a column of their own; the page each entry
starts on, with leaders, as a printed contents page.
a paper: numbers, pages, the section you are in
Typing filters the list; folded parts and
sections open to show what matches.
Nothing in the contents is called “zzzz”.
long contents: Find, whatever the accents
